admission.justification: Wiring _message_seats and open_held_store across cli/product_messages.py, cli/paseo_role_tools.py, and cli/role_held_store.py prevents product notices from recreating a retired seat's store or task folder.

applicability: Product-authored start/notice messages routed through cli/product_messages.py.
conditions: file_product_message and send_product_message pass _message_seats and translate HeldSeatClosed into recipient-archived.
exclusions: Live open seats continue to receive product messages normally.

evidence: Both files passed in the independent focused runs on code tree bebb70ce8a4582d088e0813c2842ce9007df592d. No dedicated product-message-closed-seat case exists; the shared fence is exercised by the role-message closure tests.

statement: A product message to a closed seat is refused by name before filing and opens no held store or task folder.
title: Product messages to closed seats refuse before filing or creating stores
